ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-18-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Suzan Yee, Esq. for Petitioner: Sharon Kwok, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Andrew Clifford Chin, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Andrew Clifford Pong.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-30-2004 Reset To Nov-18-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patty Lee Hubble.
Suzan Yee, Esq. for Petitioner: Sharon Kwok, not present.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and/ or proof of service or notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor: Andrew Clifford Chin, is continued to Nov. 18, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date or Order dispensing with notice.
